reasoning_content: My regex-based approach isn't capturing the right content, so I'm switching to a line-based method instead.

action.command:
cd /workspace
/workspace/.venv/bin/python << 'EOF'
lines=open('process-compose.yaml').read().split('\n')
# find '  name:' style top-level entries (2-space indent key at start)
import re
entries=[]
for i,l in enumerate(lines):
    m=re.match(r'^  ([a-z0-9_\-]+):\s*$', l)
    if m:
        entries.append((i,m.group(1)))
for idx,(start,name) in enumerate(entries):
    end=entries[idx+1][0] if idx+1<len(entries) else len(lines)
    block='\n'.join(lines[start:end])
    cmd=re.search(r'--port (\d+)', block)
    wd=re.search(r'working_dir:\s*(\S+)', block)
    if cmd and 18000<=int(cmd.group(1))<=18016:
        print(f"port {cmd.group(1)}: name={name:26s} wd={wd.group(1) if wd else ''}")
EOF
